summary: M2 first-stage payload safety is ready for review. All 41 core tests and 16 synthetic test-app tests pass with zero skips/failures; the clean build and scoped payload/trusted-context security gate pass. Evidence covers bounded Base64 detection including a 10 MB pre-queue candidate, configurable capture/structural/string/output limits, field/path/type policies, registered DTO extraction, safe optional hashing, PII handling, and queue byte accounting.
nextActions: Review the M2 public API refinements, including the NO_PAYLOAD name, registered DTO schema, expected types, and disabled-by-default binary digest policy.

Implement interceptor/plaintext-hook integration and downstream Alloy/Loki absence assertions in M3-M5; whole-platform verify-all remains intentionally non-zero until those and the M9 performance gates exist.
